shortDescription: Module for setup of GslbService Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: application_persistence_profile_ref
options.description: The federated application persistence associated with gslbservice site persistence functionality. It is a reference to an object of type applicationpersistenceprofile. Field introduced in 17.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_health_status_enabled
options.description: Gs members overall health status is derived based on a combination of controller and datapath health-status inputs. Note that the datapath status is determined by the association of health monitor profiles. Only the controller provided status is determined through this configuration. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: created_by
options.description: Creator name. Field introduced in 17.1.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: description
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: domain_names
options.description: Fully qualified domain name of the gslb service. Minimum of 1 items required. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: down_response
options.description: Response to the client query when the gslb service is down. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable or disable the gslb service. If the gslb service is enabled, then the vips are sent in the dns responses based on reachability and configured algorithm. If the gslb service is disabled, then the vips are no longer available in the dns response. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: groups
options.description: Select list of pools belonging to this gslb service. Minimum of 1 items required. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: health_monitor_refs
options.description: Verify vs health by applying one or more health monitors. Active monitors generate synthetic traffic from dns service engine and to mark a vs up or down based on the response. It is a reference to an object of type healthmonitor. Maximum of 6 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: health_monitor_scope
options.description: Health monitor probe can be executed for all the members or it can be executed only for third-party members. This operational mode is useful to reduce the number of health monitor probes in case of a hybrid scenario. In such a case, avi members can have controller derived status while non-avi members can be probed by via health monitor probes in dataplane. Enum options - GSLB_SERVICE_HEALTH_MONITOR_ALL_MEMBERS, GSLB_SERVICE_HEALTH_MONITOR_ONLY_NON_AVI_MEMBERS. Allowed with any value in enterpris

options.name: hm_off
options.description: This field is an internal field and is used in se. Field introduced in 18.2.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: include_additional_records
options.description: If enabled, provide the srv targets resolved ip in the response srv gslb service. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: This field indicates that this object is replicated across gslb federation. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: min_members
options.description: The minimum number of members to distribute traffic to. Allowed values are 1-65535. Special values are 0 - disable. Field introduced in 17.2.4. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the gslb service. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: num_dns_ip
options.description: Number of ip addresses of this gslb service to be returned by the dns service. Enter 0 to return all ip addresses. Allowed values are 1-20. Special values are 0- return all ip addresses. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: pki_profile_ref
options.description: Pki profile associated with the gslb service. It is a reference to an object of type pkiprofile. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: pool_algorithm
options.description: The load balancing algorithm will pick a gslb pool within the gslb service list of available pools. Enum options - GSLB_SERVICE_ALGORITHM_PRIORITY, GSLB_SERVICE_ALGORITHM_GEO. Field introduced in 17.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as GSLB_SERVICE_ALGORITHM_PRIORITY.

options.name: record_type
options.description: Field to specify the type of gslb service. Enum options - GSLB_SERVICE_RECORD_TYPE_A_AAAA_CNAME, GSLB_SERVICE_RECORD_TYPE_SRV. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as GSLB_SERVICE_RECORD_TYPE_A_AAAA_CNAME.

options.name: resolve_cname
options.description: This field indicates that for a cname query, respond with resolved cnames in the additional section with a records. Field introduced in 18.2.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: site_persistence_enabled
options.description: Enable site-persistence for the gslbservice. Field introduced in 17.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: topology_policy_enabled
options.description: When enabled, topology policy rules are used for member selection first. If no valid member is found using the topology policy rules, configured gslb algorithms for pool selection and member selection are used. Field introduced in 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Ttl value (in seconds) for records served for this gslb service by the dns service. Allowed values are 0-86400. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: use_edns_client_subnet
options.description: Use the client ip subnet from the edns option as source ipaddress for client geo-location and consistent hash algorithm. Default is true. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the gslb service. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vrf_uuid_for_gs
options.description: Vrf name of the dns vs to which this gs is bound to. In case it is bound to multiple dns vses on the se, this field will be inherited from the first dns vs in the configuration order. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: wildcard_match
options.description: Enable wild-card match of fqdn  if an exact match is not found in the dns table, the longest match is chosen by wild-carding the fqdn in the dns request. Default is false. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.
